title: Change modules Name FE
features:
Change the names of the modules for change the control and speed, cant change abilities or other, just the control, speed. This is of the Metal sonic and sonic (USE ON PRIVATE SERVER TO KNOW WHAT CHANGE)

By Noobs/Noob
script:
local SurvivorFolder = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    :WaitForChild("ClientAssets")
    :WaitForChild("ClientMoveset")
    :WaitForChild("Survivor")

for _, obj in ipairs(SurvivorFolder:GetChildren()) do
    if obj:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        if obj.Name == "Sonic" then
            obj.Name = "MetalSonic"
        elseif obj.Name == "MetalSonic" then
            obj.Name = "Sonic"
        end
    end
end
